symbols.name: source length of axis
symbols.meaning: The odd prime length chosen for axis a, lying just below the padded length t_a.
symbols.quote: The source length $s_a$ of axis $a$ is an odd prime, and $S=\prod_a s_a$ is the product of the source lengths, which is the length of the cyclic convolution.

symbols.name: source product
symbols.meaning: The product of the source lengths s_a over all axes, the length of the cyclic convolution.
symbols.quote: The source length $s_a$ of axis $a$ is an odd prime, and $S=\prod_a s_a$ is the product of the source lengths, which is the length of the cyclic convolution.

symbols.name: window-width parameter
symbols.meaning: A parameter with 0 < eta < 1/4 that sets the width of the prime window as a fraction of the padded length.
symbols.quote: Let $\eta$ be a window-width parameter with $0<\eta<1/4$.

symbols.name: prime variable
symbols.meaning: A prime number, chosen from a window just below a padded length.
symbols.quote: Let $\ell$ denote a prime number; this page uses $\ell$ for primes, not the position $q$ of the map page.

symbols.name: large power of two
symbols.meaning: A large power of two such that each padded length t_a equals X or 2X.
symbols.quote: Take a large power of two $X$, so that each $t_a$ is $X$ or $2X$.

relations.quote: The lengths $s_a$ are the moduli of the [Chinese-remainder map](chinese-remainder-map.md), which turns one cyclic convolution of length $S$ into a multidimensional one over the $s_a$.
The primes are sized for [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md), which needs each ratio $t_a/s_a$ to leave separation.
